# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and reliability updates**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, native reliability, and managed image and text-processing performance. The upcoming release adopts Uno Platform 7, raises Apple deployment minimums, refreshes the bundled renderer, and corrects native data handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m156 upstream fixes included** — Updates the bundled renderer with the latest Chrome m156 bug fixes. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native string data handling corrected** — FromCString now avoids reading past its native input buffer and writes directly into SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily** — Releases retained stream data once it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Managed pixel and text processing optimized** — Reduces allocation and copying overhead for image pixels, HarfBuzz UTF-32 encoding, and native feature strings. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Uno Platform 7 support added** — Builds SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI against Uno Platform 7. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Apple and Android platform support updated** — Raises Apple deployment minimums and synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native platform dependencies refreshed** — Aligns Windows dependencies with current MAUI releases, modernizes ANGLE, and includes WebGPU support in the native library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Linux HarfBuzz binding made self-contained** — Resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
